---
title: Manage Products
description: >-
  View your product list, make quick changes to item details, or delete old
  products from your system.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Products > Add Product.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="293" height="204" style="width: 293px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click to view on a specific item.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="596" height="264" style="width: 596px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Modify product details, copy button to create a new product or delete button to remove items that are no longer available from your list.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="404" height="300" style="width: 404px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
